label: D2: reached S1 via common a1 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition (100% of activations; never on a2, S2, rare transitions, D1 or GO). Inside that a1->S1c set (~25% precision alone) it is gated by recent reward history: strongest when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 86% of mass), then decays over successive rewarded a1->S1c trials (example windows: 1.0 -> 0.66 -> 0.33 -> ~0); adding an unrewarded trial two back raises mass recall to 0.92 but lowers precision. Activity also shrinks with episode time (none after trial ~90), and it is higher when the model value is high. The predicate uses only variables observed at D2 (this trial choice and reached state, previous reward). Precision is incomplete because the graded history and episode-time dependence are not captured by a boolean predicate.
